description: Wijesinghe Arachchilage Premawathi Menike v. Divisional Secretary, Imbulpe Wijesinghe Arachchilage Premawathi Menike v. Divisional Secretary, Imbulpe View More before Hon. L.T.B. Dehideniya, J
parties: Wijesinghe Arachchilage Premawathi Menike v. Divisional Secretary, Imbulpe Wijesinghe Arachchilage Premawathi Menike v. Divisional Secretary, Imbulpe View More
keywords: Land acquisition – Land acquired for expansion of Sabaragamuwa University – Recovery of possession – Earlier proceeding under State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act dismissed on technical ground – Subsequent ejectment proceeding under Land Acquisition Act – Urgent acquisition – Eleven-year delay – Delay does not divest State of acquired land – Res judicata – Earlier technical dismissal not decision on merits – Statutory acquisition scheme provides proper ejectment remedy – Magistrate’s ejectment order upheld – Appeal dismissed without costs. H.C.J. Madawala J. agreed.
legistation: Land Acquisition Act No. 9 of 1950 – proviso to section 38 and section 42(2); State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act – section 5; principles of res judicata.
